# Mission Readiness Framer — Narrative Template (optional)

Use when the run drifts into unsourced paragraph synthesis. Bullets only.

## Template

```markdown
# Mission Readiness Brief — <solicitation_id>

## Mission Readiness Frame
- Readiness outcome: <one line> [see mission_readiness_frame.source_chunk_ids]
- Workload enablers: <top 3> [see mission_readiness_frame.workload_enablers]
- **Our read:** <contract instruments readiness — not the mission itself>

## Customer pain (program office)
- PP-001: <pain> [see customer_pain_points[0].source_chunk_ids] — response: <type>
- **In our capture experience,** <pattern tying pains to readiness>

## Importance signals
- IS-001: <signal> [see importance_signals[0].source_chunk_ids]
- **Likely** the spine is <readiness-linked priority>, not <hygiene factor>.

## Implicit criteria (tea leaves)
- IC-001 customer read: <line> [see implicit_criteria[0].source_chunk_ids]
- IC-001 alternate read: <line> — confidence: <level>

## Current methods vs innovation
- CM-001: <method in place> [see current_methods[0]] — IO-001 opportunity: <quality/cost angle> [see innovation_opportunities[0]]
- **Our read:** <differentiation angle grounded in scope fit>

## Win-theme candidates (seeds only)
- WT-001: <label> — readiness link: <line> [see win_theme_candidates[0]]
- **Play:** Feed WT-001..003 into proposal-generator after eval decoder check.

## Clarifications to file
- Q1: <question> [see clarification_questions[0]]
```

Class A bullets end with anchors; Class B bullets use `**Our read:**`, `**Play:**`, `**Likely**`, `**In our capture experience,**`.
